site_role: independent transfer test; prior I-80 development selected the acceleration inverse

profiles.baseline: default IDM and legacy pedal map
profiles.inverse: same IDM with matching C3 acceleration inverse and pedal feedback

weighting: mean RMSE over common simulation seeds, normalize and square metric errors, equal weights by metric and original vehicle track
acceptance: all episodes safe and complete, upper 95 percent paired original track bootstrap interval below zero, and every mean metric RMSE no worse
failure_rule: preserve every episode; any unsafe or incomplete episode prevents acceptance
uncertainty: paired bootstrap across original vehicle tracks within the observed site
